name: Round Loop
description: The round clock the whole game hangs off: a lobby that waits for players, then waves and intermissions on repeat. The Multiplayer Server owns the phases, every player counts down to the same instant, and an empty scene parks instead of burning through waves.

changelog.notes: Initial release: server-owned lobby/wave/intermission phases, drift-free countdowns off server time, minimum-players gate with a solo switch, park-when-empty, and a cold-start resume from server storage
